notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch via curl with browser UA - full success, no blocks (robots.txt has generic Disallow rules for search/filter params but no anthropic/Claude-bot block; site is SFCC/Demandware, server-rendered HTML). TREE: built from union of sitemap_4-category.xml (754 category URLs) + homepage mega-menu links + each candidate category's own sub-nav/refinement links, then verified every leaf's <h1> and canonical URL matched the requested slug before recording. Site is primarily a furniture/mattress retailer (sofas, dining, bedroom furniture, mattresses) with a small Accessories section. Textile-relevant nodes found: Accessories > Home Furnishing > Cushions & Scatter Cushions; Accessories > Rugs > 6 rug-type subcategories (found via sitemap, 4 of 6 also linked from homepage nav, all verified live with matching canonical); Bedroom > Bedding & Pillows > Mattress Protectors, Mattress Toppers, Pillows. QTY: each qty taken from the exact 'View N items' button text on the category listing page (the site's own aggregate count before pagination). EXCLUDED: /accessories/home-furnishing/throws/ - this URL loads but its canonical redirects to the parent /accessories/home-furnishing/ and its h1 reads 'Home Furnishing' not 'Throws', proving it is a refinement/filter view, not a genuine standalone category page, so it fails the h1/canonical-match rule and was dropped. /bedroom/bedding-and-pillows/duvets/ - 302-redirects to the parent /bedroom/bedding-and-pillows/ (broken/retired slug), so excluded as not a live category. Color and shape refinement links under Rugs/Cushions (e.g. /rugs/blue/, /rugs/round/, /cushions/beige/) excluded as filters, not category nodes. Pillows marked confidence MEDIUM: the site groups it under 'Bedding & Pillows' (a bedding textile category) but the textile.md rule list explicitly enumerates 'Pillowcases'/'Pillow Shams' rather than the bare pillow product, so it is a reasonable-but-not-certain textile call. STORAGE: no genuine storage boxes/baskets/organizers/racks/carts category exists anywhere on the site (exhaustive sitemap keyword sweep for storage/organiz/basket/box/crate/bin/caddy/trolley/cart returned nothing outside furniture). The only nodes with 'storage' in the URL path (living-room/storage/{sideboards,bookcases,tv-stands,display-cabinets}, dining-room/storage/{bookcases,shelves}, bedroom/kids-bedroom/kids-storage, bedroom/beds/ottoman-and-storage-beds, sofas-and-armchairs/footstools/storage-footstools) are all storage FURNITURE (sideboards, bookcases, TV units, wardrobes, storage cubes, storage beds/footstools) explicitly placed by the site under Furniture-hierarchy categoryPath values (e.g. 'Bedroom/Bedroom furniture/Kids storage' - confirmed via the page's own DataLayerDTO product JSON), so per storage.md SS21/27 (explicit Furniture-category placement wins) these belong to the already-validated Furniture.xlsx, not Storage.xlsx - storage_rows is correctly empty. No curtains, blinds, towels, tablecloths, napkins, aprons, or bathroom-textile categories exist on the site at all (confirmed absent via sitemap-wide keyword sweep).
